title: About Fixes & Debugging
content:
Thank you for taking the time to visit YURI NO1.

YURI NO1 is a one-person creative project, created, built, and maintained by a single creator alongside regular life and work. Its development continues with attention to design, usability, and other improvements based on the Creator's own experience using the website and the aspects that can be observed and improved.

There is currently no additional human staff or support team assisting with development, proofreading, content review, or other quality checks. As a result, there may occasionally be oversights in website functionality, spelling, proofreading, or other details, and some improvements may take time to implement.

YURI NO1 sincerely apologizes for any imperfections or delays you may encounter, and appreciates your patience and understanding.

Thank you for your kind support.
